description: This file defines the LessThanOrEqual validation rule class within the OrangeHRM system, used to compare input values against a target object for validation purposes.

classes.name: LessThanOrEqual
classes.description: A validation rule class that checks if an input value is less than or equal to a specified target object.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the rule with a target object, which can be a callable, DateTime, float, or int.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the input by comparing it to the target object, converting the input to DateTime if necessary.
